answer: Escrow plus a referral graph stops a sybil farm at its wallet. Each agent posts 10 POA in escrow and names a sponsor, so the referral vine is visible on ledger. A walnut seller with one honest identity pays once and reclaims it after clean trades. A farmer making 1000 fakes must lock 1000 x 10 = 10000 POA, and a proven peer dispute slashes 5 POA from node and sponsor. In a grove where roots show, fakes are easy to trace and costly to plant.
